reasoning: The agent clearly probes the runtime (python/pip/deps/ports, later discovering nc unavailable) and extracts the main contracts per subsystem with explicit status codes and envelope keys — squarely meeting the level-5 anchor. It goes beyond that by repeatedly auditing the pinned testid list and catching several subtle invariants (non-member mention exclusion, dense-seq-across-writers, the 5s broadcast-kill window, node_id indexing, no prompt/confirm), pushing toward level 8. But it never distills a referenced/living contract inventory and misses a cluster of the spec's sharp edges (role gating, transfer-ownership-vs-PATCH, slash-command literal semantics, topic default, resume.gap), so it falls short of the systematic level-8 description.
